claims.head: Watch the Islanders’ puck management
claims.call: The Rangers get at least their usual 7.5% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
claims.body: The Rangers turn stolen pucks into chances, and the Islanders are one of the league’s worst at avoiding breakdowns. A sloppy pass or two could cost the Islanders.
claims.nums: NY Rangers 10th for chances off turnovers (7.5% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · NY Islanders 31st for avoiding breakdowns
claims.gist: The Rangers pounce on loose pucks, and the Islanders cough them up.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 2 games this season

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: The Rangers’ power play has a target
claims.call: The Rangers’ power play creates at least their usual 7.7 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Islanders’ penalty kill is one of the league’s worst, and the Rangers’ power play is near the top of the league. Discipline matters more than usual for the Islanders tonight.
claims.nums: NY Rangers 10th for power play (7.7 expected goals per 60) · NY Islanders 30th for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Rangers’ power play has a soft target in the Islanders’ kill.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 2 games this season

check.measure: expected goals per 60 on the power play
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Bodies will fly
claims.call: The two teams’ combined hit score reaches their usual 112.
claims.body: The Islanders and the Rangers are both among the league’s heaviest hitters, even after adjusting for each arena’s scorer. Keep your head up.
claims.nums: Hit score (100 is league average): NY Islanders 107 (9th), NY Rangers 118 (2nd)

NYR.head: The Rangers should have the upper hand
NYR.body: The Islanders have had more of the chances over recent games and the Rangers have home ice. The Islanders’ way back in is keeping shots to a minimum.

NYI.head: A tough matchup for the Islanders
NYI.body: The Islanders have had more of the chances over recent games and the Rangers have home ice. The Islanders can pull it off if they keep shots to a minimum.

story.head: Watch the Islanders’ puck management
